scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Hello, what business are you here for?

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: If you wish to join the Illusion Investigation Corps, you're lacking in skills yet.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Please visit again when you have reached a certain level.
^4d4dff== You must be level 100 or higher to join. ==^000000

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Hello, I'm Joel, the Commander of the Illusion Investigation Corps.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Have you ever heard of or experienced illusions?

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Until now, illusions have been discovered all over the world and are somewhat known to the public.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: It is also used as a hunting ground for many adventurers because it is easy to obtain rare materials.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Also, the monsters in Illusion are new monsters that have never been discovered before, and the monsters in Illusion are multiplying abnormally.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Despite many adventurers hunting the monsters that exist in Illusion to obtain materials, the reason for the very rapid recovery of the population has not been identified.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Our Illusion Investigation Team was organized to uncover the mystery of the Illusion, and first we decided to figure out the ecology of the monsters inside the Illusion.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: What we found was that all illusions are affected by dimensional rifts.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: I've been speculating that it might be related to the dimensional rift for a long time, but with the results of this investigation, it's clear.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: There are still many adventurers visiting Illusion with a purpose, so the monster population is fortunately maintained.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: If no one sets foot there, it's very dangerous because the monsters can go beyond saturation and invade other areas.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: For that reason, the number of individuals is still being investigated, and one investigator is currently assigned to each illusion.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: And we're recruiting members with the ability to control the number of monsters inside Illusion.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: And if you're an adventurer, you seem to be strong enough for that role...

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Would you like to join the Illusion Investigation Team and join us in investigating illusions?
I'm joining
I'll think about it

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: It's very meaningful.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Please think about it before you tell me.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Okay, you're welcome!!

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: The procedure is simple, please fill out the pledge here...

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Here... please sign this.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Yes, with this you have become a member of the Illusionary Survey Corps, welcome again!

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: If you have time during your adventure, I would like you to stop by the Illusions located in various places and help me with the investigation.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: A dispatched investigator will guide you.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Then I hope you have a nice day

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: I think the investigation will be much easier thanks to you, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: New illusions will appear again.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Every new discovery takes a lot of time for us to adapt to it

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: This investigation will at least help reduce that time.

scripts.speaker: Commander Joel
scripts.text: Thank you and look forward to many more activities in the future.

scripts.speaker: Member Zenhi
scripts.text: Hello~~!!

scripts.speaker: Member Zenhi
scripts.text: The Illusion Investigation Corps is getting bigger little by little.

scripts.speaker: Member Zenhi
scripts.text: The more members, the more things we can do, right?

scripts.speaker: Member Zenian
scripts.text: Hello, I'm Zenian, a new member of the team.

scripts.speaker: Member Zenian
scripts.text: I've been paying attention to the phenomenon of dimensional rifts for a long time. Clearly, despite many subjugations, monsters are constantly appearing.

scripts.speaker: Member Zenian
scripts.text: It has been proven that this phenomenon also occurs in illusions, so I decided to join the Illusion Investigation Team.

scripts.speaker: Member Zenian
scripts.text: Good luck in the future!!

scripts.speaker: Member link
scripts.text: Nice to meet you, this is the Welcome Survey Team.

scripts.speaker: Member link
scripts.text: Investigate the ecosystem of monsters in Illusion...

scripts.speaker: Member link
scripts.text: Also... I thought it might have something to do with the dimensional rift.

scripts.speaker: Member link
scripts.text: I hope that everyone who is working hard at this time will return safely without any incident.

scripts.text: I am J-Girocker from the Illusion Investigation Corps.

scripts.speaker: Girocker

scripts.text: Hello!!

scripts.text: I am J-Girocker from the Illusion Investigation Corps.

scripts.text: I usually pretended to be brave, but I think I was conscious of Elysia, the member I have a crush on.

Participate

scripts.text: Then should I ask another adventurer...

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: I like it!!

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: Then be careful!

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: Ah, that's enough for today's investigation.

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: It will be restored tomorrow, so if you can afford it, I would appreciate it if you could come and help me with the investigation!!

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: The content is the same as last time.

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: It would be nice if you could help me today...

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: I like it!!

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: Then be careful!

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: Kill 100 monsters of any type.

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: You're back safely!

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: Okay... Then hmm... I'll have to wait and see how much monsters spawn for a while.

scripts.speaker: Girocker
scripts.text: Leave the rest to me!! Thanks!!

scripts.text: Oh, must you have a hard time enduring the cold here?

scripts.text: I'm Elysia from the Illusion Investigation Team~

scripts.text: It's really cold here...

scripts.text: Hello~

scripts.text: I'm Elysia from the Illusion Investigation Team~

scripts.text: It's really cold here...

scripts.text: I never thought I would be sent to such a dangerous place alone... I wanted to come with Jirocker...

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Well, even if there was a Jirocker, he's a coward, so I'd be in a position to protect him...

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: You pretended to be brave... but I already noticed

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Is Jirocker doing his investigation safely in the abandoned village? I'm worried.

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Hmm... Actually, now is not the time to worry about Jirocker, Adventurer. Can you help me?

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Did you hear that this is an investigation into how the monster population is maintained? Many adventurers come here to hunt, but it's a bit lacking.

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: It's easy to figure out the number of monsters when you deal with them hotly. How about you? Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Yeah, that's right...

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Then I'll be shivering a little longer...

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Oh yes!! Thanks!!

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: I look forward to your hot hunting skills~~!!

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Ah, I think this should be enough for today!!

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: If you come after tomorrow, you'll have something else to do~

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Ah, nice to meet you!! Are you here today to help with the investigation??

Participate

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Thank you

scripts.speaker: Elysia

scripts.speaker: Elysia

scripts.speaker: Elysia
scripts.text: Thank you for your hard work. I hope we can meet again!!

scripts.text: Hello, Adventurer

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: But I've always been interested in the phenomenon of illusion, and when the investigation team was founded, I actively applied for membership.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Because nobody has figured it out yet

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: It's just the beginning of the current investigation, but it's sure to be a great first step

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Therefore, fear can be overcome by will.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Investigation preparations are complete, now I'm waiting for someone who can adjust the monsters' levels.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: How about you, why don't you participate in the investigation? You joined the investigation team for that, right?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: I'll stay here

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Good.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: The sooner the better.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Then I'll be waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: That's it for today.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: If the current trend, I think we can resume the investigation in a day or so. Please come then.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Please execute the operation as it was then.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Would you like to participate in the task of killing 100 monsters of any type?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: You acted meaninglessly, I'm disappointed.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Thank you

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Kill 100 monsters of any type.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Then I'll be waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: Kill 100 monsters of any type.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: You came through quickly, thank you.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: That makes it easier to work out the numbers.

scripts.speaker: Radimir
scripts.text: I will finish the rest of the work soon and report it to the investigation team. Thank you for your hard work.

scripts.speaker: Machoko

scripts.text: I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~

scripts.text: I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... He looks easy... but he's so strong...

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: I thought I could do it all by myself... I took it too lightly... Huh...

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: I unknowingly and vigorously attacked and came back with a lot of beating... I almost died...

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: I barely recovered... I think it's possible to investigate, but you look a little strong?

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Then help me... I need someone to take control of those vicious teddy bears...

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: How about it? Do you want to join the investigation??
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Yes... I'm about to collapse after I've been here... Like a man without blood or tears...

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Okay! Let's go!!

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: I... can't even move... Here... I'll wait...

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Well, no more today

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Come back after a day!!

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Oh, nice to meet you! Welcome back!

scripts.speaker: Machoko

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Would you like to participate in the investigation work here again today??
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Machoko

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Sure, that's how it should be

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Regardless of the type, just beat 100 of them and bring them back.

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: I'll be waiting for you, so hurry up!!

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: I've been waiting for you... finish quickly and come back...

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Um...but that's about it... um...yeah!! good!!

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Leave the rest to me!! I'll report the results to the investigation team, now you can go and rest.

scripts.speaker: Machoko
scripts.text: Thank you~~

scripts.text: Hello!

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: The Illumination Investigation Team is a newly formed organization, so it must have been a little understaffed. I saw an announcement that they would hire part-time contract workers.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Actually, I'm not interested in illusions... I'm busy making a living.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Huh... It's all about money, I'm going to buy a new set of clothes when I get paid.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: But even that isn't easy... I've been waiting for an investigator like you to come because I think it's going to be very difficult on my own.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Would you like to participate in this Illusion Investigation?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Ah... I finally found an investigator... Ah... I want money...

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Oh, thank you

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Please go up one floor from here and go to the bleak Guyang Palace.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: And please kill 100 monsters there, regardless of type.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: I'll be waiting for you here. Have a safe trip!!

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: You're not fit to do research right now.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: I think it will be fine by tomorrow, can you come back after tomorrow?

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Hello, you are the only one who can help me...

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: What we need to do is the same as last time...

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Are you going to help me with the illusion investigation again?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Aigoo...

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Oops... Thank you...

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Go to the bleak archery and kill 100 monsters of any type.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Then be careful...

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Destroy 100 monsters of any type in the bleak Archery.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: You came home safely.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Uh... You took it down a lot faster than I expected.. You... you were a master??

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: That should make the rest of the work easier.

scripts.speaker: Orian
scripts.text: Thank you~ Thank you for your hard work!!

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Nice to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I am Sheshin belonging to the Illusion Investigation Corps.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I thought my fighting power would be enough to investigate here... but I guess I made a mistake.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Ah... I'm really proud of myself... but I need help... Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Adventurer hasn't joined the Illusion Investigation Team yet.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Would you like to join the Illusionary Investigation Team? Wouldn't it be exciting to explore unknown phenomena?

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: If you would like to sign up, please go see Commander <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Nice to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I am Sheshin belonging to the Illusion Investigation Corps.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I was active as a member of the Continental Guard in the past. At that time, I was tasked with exploring the dimensional rift created by the power of the demon king Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I was guessing to some extent that the illusions appearing everywhere had something to do with the power of the dimensional rift.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: It has been officially announced by Commander Joel that the Illusion is a phenomenon caused by a dimensional rift.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: And soon a new illusion was discovered, yes... right here

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I joined the Illusion Investigation Team because I wanted to see it with my own eyes, and now I am here.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: But I ran into a little problem...

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I thought my fighting power would be enough to investigate here... but I guess I made a mistake.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Ah... I really hurt my pride... but I need help...

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Hmm... I think it's possible enough for you as an adventurer...

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I feel that you have much more power than me.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Would you like to help me investigate the illusions in this sector?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: This must be a good opportunity for adventurers...

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Good.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Please kill 100 monsters of any type located inside here.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Then, please travel carefully without getting hurt.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: You don't have to do any more research today.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Can you come back tomorrow if you want?

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Welcome, you're here to help investigate the illusion, right?

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: You can do the same thing as last time.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: It's a pity, it's sad that I still lack strength.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Good.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Then, please travel carefully without getting hurt.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Kill 100 monsters of any type.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I see... you finished quickly and came back.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I need to investigate further to see if the phenomenon here is also affected by the dimensional rift.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: I'll do the work myself from now on.

scripts.speaker: Sheshin
scripts.text: Thank you so much for your help

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Hello.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: This is Cassis of the Illusion Investigation Corps.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: I heard that one of the investigators is coming to help... is that you?

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Oh, that's not true. You're not a member of the investigation team... Hmm.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Would you like to join the Illusionary Investigation Team too? Would you like to investigate strange phenomena?

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: If you don't mind, please apply for membership with the Commander <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera and come!

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Hello

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: This is Cassis of the Illusion Investigation Corps.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: I don't like to get involved with people. Before I joined the investigation team, I ran a shop in Prontera...

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: I don't like the feeling of being crowded, so it was hard to bear... I guess meeting a lot of people was stressful for my personality.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here, at least the monsters don't talk to me.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Ummm, by the way, I heard that one of the investigators is coming to help... I guess that's you?

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Have you heard the general information from Captain Joel? You just need to display your fighting power without hesitation!!

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
Participate
Do not participate

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Uh, then who the hell is the investigative team coming...?

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Okay, thank you

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Just kill 100 monsters of any type that exist here.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
scripts.text: Then good luck.

scripts.text: Today's investigation is complete.

scripts.speaker: Cassis
